pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/cache.rs:457 The only LLM-adjacent construct here is a request-keyed TTL response cache (plus a VCR cassette store) that replays identical Claude answers to save cost; it does not capture, consolidate, decay or inject anything an agent carries forward, and a case-insensitive search of crates/core/src and crates/core/tests for agent_memory, episodic, consolidat and memory_store found no hits.

pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: crates/server/src/routes/health.rs:1 These are operational HTTP handlers (health, doctor, economics, meta, SSE events, triggers, watches) with no agent memory store or recall-into-prompt path; a case-insensitive search of crates/server/src/routes for agent_memory, episodic, consolidat and memory_store found no hits (Claude appears only as a cost/engine label in economics.rs).

pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: plugins-src/trigger-gate/src/lib.rs:1 The plugins are stateless wasm32 extraction/predicate functions over a JSON envelope ("memory" here means wasm linear memory), so there is no agent memory pipeline; a case-insensitive search of plugins-src for agent_memory, episodic, consolidat and memory_store found no hits.

pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/resilience/mod.rs:1 The module keeps rolling-window extraction-health counters and enforcement state per scraping app, which is not an agent's carried-forward memory; a case-insensitive search of crates/core/src (including resilience/) and crates/core/tests for agent_memory, episodic, consolidat and memory_store found no hits.

pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: crates/apps/grants-common/src/lib.rs:1 These are deterministic scrapers that normalize grant records into datasets; the only "recall" hits are precision-over-recall comments about record identity matching, not memory recall, and a case-insensitive search of the five grant crates for agent_memory, episodic, consolidat and memory_store found no hits.
